achievements.name: Fresh Prince of Trudograd
achievements.description: The city welcomes you!

achievements.name: An Old Friend
achievements.description: Your car from the Central Wasteland stands in the outskirts of Trudograd.

achievements.name: Mysterious Knife
achievements.description: You solved the riddle of the stalker Igor knife.

achievements.name: Atomic Soda
achievements.description: You bought a glass of every Atom agent favorite drink!

achievements.name: Power of Simplicity
achievements.description: You had faith in your luck and stood by your words..!

achievements.name: Baby Eater
achievements.description: Yes, you really did eat a child. Or, at least, somebody thinks that you did…

achievements.name: Goose Sacrifice
achievements.description: You actively and successfully use your Luck. The goose death wasn’t in vain!

achievements.name: Holy Mountain
achievements.description: You died from a lethal dose of The Truth™.

achievements.name: Human Antidote
achievements.description: You survived the worst poisoning of your whole Atom career.

achievements.name: Viva La Revolution
achievements.description: You became a part-time revolutionary.

achievements.name: Freelance Police
achievements.description: You're temping as a freelance police officer.

achievements.name: Lot 49
achievements.description: You opened a mysterious chest on Kolotushkin Street.

achievements.name: Memoirs of a Nibbler
achievements.description: You listened to all the haiku of a four-legged intellectual.

achievements.name: KGB Bunker
achievements.description: You’ve been contacted by the eponymous KGB bunker.

achievements.name: Shadow over Trudograd
achievements.description: You performed the ancient ritual and met guests from the depths…

achievements.name: Death of the Author
achievements.description: If the author is writing about you, then who is writing about the author?

achievements.name: Sick Freak
achievements.description: You performed such a heinous and convoluted act that… you deserve an achievement!

achievements.name: Escalation of Conflict
achievements.description: You turned a simple arrest into a real street battle.

achievements.name: Sixth Sense
achievements.description: You exorcised all the restless spectres that you met on your path.

achievements.name: Second Thought
achievements.description: You completed the cow mission, but then decided to bring her back.

achievements.name: Terrorist
achievements.description: You single-handedly signed Trudograd’s death warrant.

achievements.name: Walking Fortress
achievements.description: You maxed-out your special armor.

achievements.name: Fight Club
achievements.description: You became the ruling champion of the factory arena!

achievements.name: Incompetence
achievements.description: You showed a surprising lack of competence in completing a rather easy task in the city docks.

achievements.name: Rising Star
achievements.description: You won ten games of Bombagun, playing for money.

achievements.name: Albino Bloodsucker
achievements.description: You tracked and killed the albino bloodsucker.

achievements.name: Bronzovka
achievements.description: You learned something that you shouldn't have...

achievements.name: Admiral
achievements.description: Congratulations! You sank all the battleships!

achievements.name: Goodbye ATOM
achievements.description: After completing your mission you left the ATOM organization.

achievements.name: Household
achievements.description: You’ve built your own base.

achievements.name: Commando
achievements.description: You got Big Jug at your disposal.

achievements.name: The Great and Powerful
achievements.description: You’ve met Positronium in the flesh.
